prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a finished wide landscape 16:9 background asset for NAVI, a 2D children's narrative videogame. Input references: the two supplied NAVI design images are artistic reference only; do not reproduce their UI or typography. Lush painterly storybook fantasy, detailed hand-painted anime-inspired environmental art, soft sunlight, turquoise rivers and golden sunlit paths. Floating garden island in clouds, a park with big oak tree, blue pond and small timber information cottage in the LEFT MIDDLE, winding stone bridges leading to a cozy village plaza in the RIGHT MIDDLE, distant graceful castle, floating smaller islands and waterfalls, dark leafy foreground framing edges. Composition: wide panoramic immersive world with rich depth; central bottom path leads into park; open blue sky at upper left for game logo, landscape remains uncluttered enough for interactive map markers. Palette teal, spring green, warm cream, muted gold and sky blue. No characters, no lettering, no UI, no logos, no buttons. Polished original game background, not a screenshot mockup.

Use case: illustration-story. Finished original production illustration for NAVI children's 2D narrative game. Reference image is a STYLE AND CHARACTER reference, not an edit target. Keep its lush finely painted storybook anime environmental art, turquoise sky, warm golden light, deep leafy framing and warm gentle emotions. Landscape 16:9. Characters: the same small 8-year-old explorer with short tousled brown hair, cream hooded jacket, teal shorts and small teal backpack in every scene. NAVI is the same floating lime-green leaf spirit from the reference, cream oval face and glowing pale oval eyes, layered green leaf mane and flowing pink petal tail, curved antenna, no legs. Adults warm and recognizable: guardian is a brown-haired woman in a mustard cardigan and cream trousers; park staff wears teal jacket and clearly visible round information badge. Place storytelling characters in central 60%, above bottom 28% reserved as darker ground for dialogue overlay. No text, no UI, no labels, no frame, no watermark. A single complete scene, not a collage. Specific scene: Wide beautiful park playground under a huge oak. Small wooden slide and swing at left, distant timber information cottage right, blue pond middle background. The explorer stands looking around a little uncertain after losing sight of guardian, with NAVI beside them offering reassurance. Guardian is not visible. Safe bright inviting park, daisies, drifting leaves; no danger or scary expressions.
